notes: p. 56: read only the two rows under 'PLATE XI.—Upper Register' (ārit ... semà); stopped at the rule before the Lepsius lines. p. 57 has 9 printed hieroglyph rows (not 10) and p. 58 has 9 (not 11) in this scan; all read. p. 59 read to 'Re - stau.' before 'The Fourth Ārit'. Margin labels First/Second/Third Ārit not recorded; hall field used; line numbers restart per hall (hall 1: 1-17, hall 2: 1-9, hall 3: 1-8). Words split across rows: àneb (O36 at start of p.57 row 9) and Qeq - ḥauatu - (G43 Aa2 Z2 at start of p.59 row 3) kept whole with the line of their first sign. The curled flat sign (upcurled left end, tab at right) is coded U15 throughout per the house ruling, though it acts as an arm determinative (user, θes, χesef, sati, Useṭ...); the same flat sign without the curl (tab only) is coded D36 where Budge reads ā (ārit, t'ābet, māk, sāḥ, maāt, Maāta). Seated figures: hand-to-face figure A2 (ren, semà, Qeq...), kneeling arm-raised figure A1 (nuk, suffixes), cloaked long-wig figure A40 (gods' names, ur, sāḥ). Overlines checked one by one: p56 ārit ṭep; ren (row 2 first); ren en (row 2 second); p57 t'eṭṭu àn; ārit ṭept; ànet'-ḥrà-k; neb à rer en; p58 ārit sen; ten ḥems-f ḥer / àrit ṭep em χemet ut'ā; p59 ārit χemt; t'eṭ àn.
